body:
Three suites, three invocations, easy to skip one. Add ./verify-all.sh at repo
root: server (.venv pytest), web (vitest run, tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json,
oxlint), android (gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug --offline with
JAVA_HOME=~/.sdkman/candidates/java/current). Fail fast, print a summary table.
title: verify-all script running server pytest + web vitest/tsc/lint + Android test/lint
